title: The Body Renews Its Stomach Lining In 5 Days, Not Every Cell
hook: Your stomach renews in 5 days; your whole body never does.
closing: Every tissue keeps its own clock, so the replacement myth fails.
question: Which body clock surprised you?

segments.say: The stomach lining renews in about 5 days, while slower tissues follow different clocks.
Replacement reaches 30 trillion cells cumulatively, not in one full-body reset.
Skin is 28 days old here, while cortical neurons persist vastly longer.
